headline: Sensex and Nifty rally ahead of RBI MPC outcome while Persistent Systems plans Rs 11,800 crore fundraise

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Anticipation of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting outcome
Positive momentum from the previous session where Sensex rose 685 points
Global cues from Kospi and Taiwan markets influencing investor sentiment
Market rebound in early trade following previous volatility
whatHappening: Persistent Systems shareholders approved a plan to raise up to Rs 11,800 crore
Sensex and Nifty 50 settled significantly higher in the most recent session
Brent crude forecasts have been lifted to $98 due to geopolitical tensions in Iran
IT, Realty, and PSU Bank sectors ended in the red during the previous market close
summary: Indian markets are trading with positive momentum as investors await the RBI MPC meeting results. Persistent Systems is in focus after securing shareholder approval for a massive capital raise of Rs 11,800 crore. Global factors, including rising crude oil prices and international market cues, continue to influence domestic sentiment.
